# Parse the note content to extract song titles and artists for TODO entries
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the header line
song_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('- ')]
songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Format: - Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY or TODO
    # Use regex to extract title, artists, and release info
    m = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT (.+)', line)
    if m:
        title = m.group(1).strip()
        artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
        release = m.group(3).strip()
        # Split artists by comma
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
        songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'release': release})
    else:
        print("Could not parse line:", line)

# Print the TODO songs
todo_songs = [s for s in songs if s['release'] == 'TODO']
print("TODO songs count:", len(todo_songs))
for s in todo_songs:
    print(s)
